bands: once per shot the editor reads
every frame of a read shot
once per use in our films

stages.does: take a source film from the archive, with who paid for it and why
stages.puts: title, year, maker; who paid for the film and why

stages.does: cut the film into shots where the picture changes
stages.tool: the archive's own shot pass (named in each clip's path)
stages.trained: not ours; its pass is named in each clip's path
stages.puts: shot boundaries: where a shot starts and ends
stages.blind: a dissolve or a slow pan can be cut wrong

stages.does: write each of the 45 signs as one question and a test that tells it from its neighbours
stages.puts: one question per sign and a test that tells it from its neighbours
stages.blind: the table is a reading of Deleuze, not Deleuze

stages.does: turn each question into scene phrases and run them on the archive's shot search
stages.trained: its model is the archive's, not ours
stages.puts: the shots it returns for a sign's scene phrases, ranked
stages.blind: it finds what the words describe, and nothing the words leave out

stages.does: take the archive's thumbnail: the one frame every machine looks at
stages.blind: every machine downstream sees only this frame, not the motion

stages.does: turn the frame into 512 numbers, then lay every shot out so close numbers sit close: the picture map
stages.trained: LAION-2B: about two billion web images and their alt-text
stages.puts: 512 numbers per frame; t-SNE turns them into a place on the picture map
stages.blind: it knows what the web writes under pictures, not what a film means; far apart on the map means little

stages.does: score the frame against 20 subjects and 5 shot scales
stages.puts: a score for each of 20 subject words and 5 shot scales
stages.blind: it can only answer with the words it is given

stages.does: write one plain sentence of what the frame shows
stages.trained: web image-text pairs, fine-tuned on COCO captions
stages.puts: one plain sentence of what is visible
stages.blind: names no people, places or dates; repeats the obvious noun

stages.does: measure loudness and whether it is speech, music or silence
stages.blind: run only on clips the lab downloaded

stages.does: turn the sound into numbers, name it from 30 everyday sounds, and lay the heard shots out by sound: the sound map
stages.model: LAION CLAP · HTS-AT audio encoder (unfused), then UMAP
stages.puts: 512 numbers per sound, the two closest of 30 everyday sounds, and a place on the sound map
stages.blind: old optical tracks and narration over music blur together

stages.does: compare the frame with each sign's words and read examples; keep the 3 closest as places to look
stages.trained: LAION-2B plus the editor's read shots as examples
stages.puts: a percentage for each of the 45 signs; the top 3 are places to look
stages.blind: it is a pointer, not a reading: it matches looks, not functions

stages.does: write down every word spoken, with the second it is said
stages.trained: about 680,000 hours of web audio with transcripts
stages.puts: every word spoken, with the second it is said
stages.blind: mishears archival narration; never knows who is speaking

stages.does: lay a sign's search results on a contact sheet; keep the shots that answer its question
stages.model: the editor, at a contact sheet
stages.puts: keep or drop, one shot at a time
stages.blind: only shots a search returned ever reach the sheet

stages.does: write one sentence naming the sign and what in the frame answers its question
stages.puts: the sign and one sentence on what in the frame answers its question

stages.does: score the reading: how sure in context, how sure from the shot alone, which rival sign, what would flip it
stages.puts: how sure, in context and from the shot alone; the rival sign; what would flip it
stages.blind: a score of the editor's own certainty

stages.does: find the second in the clip where the read frame sits
stages.puts: the second where the read frame sits in the clip

stages.does: cut out the figure the reading is about and follow it frame by frame
stages.trained: SA-1B / SA-V masks; CLIP picks the figure the reading names
stages.puts: the figure cut out and followed frame by frame
stages.blind: only for read shots; picks by the reading's words

stages.does: place the shot in one of our films
stages.trained: the census of what each film uses
stages.puts: where the shot goes: which film, which scene, what job
